title: Little Red Riding Hood: The Girl in the Red Cap
galleryTitle: Little Red Riding Hood: The Girl in the Red Cap
author: Brothers Grimm
descriptionEn: A rich, beginner-friendly English retelling of the Brothers Grimm tale Little Red Cap. Ten chapters with full scenes and dialogue, the second wolf from the original story, and a vocabulary guide.
descriptionPt: Um reconto rico e acessível, em inglês simples, do conto Chapeuzinho Vermelho dos Irmãos Grimm. Dez capítulos com cenas e diálogos completos, o segundo lobo do conto original e um guia de vocabulário.
adaptationCredit: Adapted for beginner learners (A1) for Bookmoo. New text written from the structure of the tale; not a copy of any published translation.
sources: Brothers Grimm, Kinder- und Haus-Märchen, KHM 26 'Rotkäppchen' (1st ed. 1812; 7th ed. 1857). Read in the historical English translation in Project Gutenberg #2591 (Edgar Taylor / Marian Edwardes) to confirm events and order.
Charles Perrault, Le Petit Chaperon rouge (1697): historical context only.
rights: Original tale: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm died in 1863 and 1859, so the work is in the public domain worldwide (Brazil: life + 70 years, long expired). The adaptation is new original text written for Bookmoo and copies no translation. Cover: original artwork made for Bookmoo, with no film characters or third-party marks.
